newsitem.title: UK: OPEC basket price fell to $20.57 last week.
newsitem.headline: OPEC basket price fell to $20.57 last week.

text.p: The price of OPEC's basket of seven crudes fell to $20.57 per barrel last week from $22.07 the previous week, the OPEC news agency OPECNA said on Monday.
It said that according to figures released by the OPEC Secretariat in Vienna, the price of the basket so far this year (up to February 13) has averaged $22.57 a barrel.
The basket averaged $23.19 in January, $23.51 in December and $22.23 in November.
The basket comprises Algeria's Saharan Blend, Indonesia's Minas, Nigeria's Bonny Light, Saudi Arabia's Arabian Light, Dubai of the UAE, Venezuela's Tia Juana and Mexico's Isthmus.
